mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite a sustained FEDFUNDS increase, or rank IC > 0.05 over any 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly rise in GDPC1 above 23,000 billions of chained 2017 dollars indicates robust demand, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to exceed baseline by 5% in a period of sustained GDPC1 growth, or rank IC < 0.03 over any 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: An abrupt monthly increase in PAYEMS above 159,000 persons signals labor market expansion, reducing wage growth expectations and boosting corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not outperform by 5% during periods of sustained PAYEMS growth above 159,000, or rank IC < 0.03 over any 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE below 3.5%), reduced labor market friction and stronger job growth lower risk premiums, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE staying below 3.5%, or rank IC < 0.03 over any 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in INDPRO above 105 indicates robust supply conditions, lowering production costs and enhancing corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to exceed baseline by 5% during sustained INDPRO growth above 105, or rank IC < 0.03 over any 60-day window.

mechanism_narrative: An abrupt monthly increase in PAYEMS above 159,000 persons signals labor market expansion, reducing wage growth expectations and boosting corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not outperform by 5% during periods of sustained PAYEMS growth above 159,000, or rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: In an expansionary monetary policy regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), reduced long-term interest rates and increased liquidity boost equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to exceed baseline by 5% during periods of FEDFUNDS >5.0%, or rank IC < 0.03 over any 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicators signals a balanced macro environment, reducing uncertainty and fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to exceed baseline by 5% during periods of concurrent GDPC1 and INDPRO growth, or rank IC < 0.03 over any 60-day window.
